messages:
amy-partnerships: quick ping to @nimbus-ops — were finalizing marketplace pricing mappings and need a few concrete inputs for cost + cashflow models. can you toss over a CSV with: region, sku, gpu_type, reserved_per_gpu_hour, commit_tenor_months, spot_per_gpu_hour, avg_eviction_pct_30d, cross_region_eviction_covariance, marketplace_listing_fee_pct, invoice_lag_days, billing_mode, upfront_pct, prorate_policy, notes?

noah-business: framing: finance will run cashflow + amortization (12mo baseline) and ops will simulate fallback using your covariance numbers. we also need whether reserved pricing is per-GPU or per-instance so we can normalize.

nimbus-ops: hey all — uploaded a short CSV to the partner portal and pasted the head below. full sheet includes separate storage/egress rows and a per-rack vulnerability note. link: https://partners.nimbuscompute.example/pricing/NC-pricing-2026 (access: redwood-partners@)

```csv
region,sku,gpu_type,reserved_per_gpu_hour,commit_tenor_months,spot_per_gpu_hour,avg_eviction_pct_30d,cross_region_eviction_covariance,marketplace_listing_fee_pct,invoice_lag_days,billing_mode,upfront_pct,prorate_policy,notes
us-west-2,NC-A100-40GB,A100-40GB,1.20,12,0.45,6,0.10,4.5,10,monthly_in_arrears,25,pro-rate-on-scale-down,no network included; storage billed separate
eu-west-1,NC-H100-80GB,H100-80GB,4.80,12,1.55,9,0.12,4.5,12,monthly_in_arrears,30,pro-rate+true-up at month end,reserved is per-instance (2x GPUs)
asia-east-1,NC-A100-80GB,A100-80GB,2.30,6,0.85,11,0.08,4.5,14,hourly,20,no refund for early termination,spot less stable during region peak
```

nimbus-bot: File uploaded: NC-pricing-2026.csv (shared to #partnerships)

zara-ops: thanks. can you confirm the covariance field semantics? is that pairwise Pearson-style covariance between region eviction rates (0-1) or a multiplier we should apply to independent probability?

nimbus-ops: good catch. cross_region_eviction_covariance is a correlation-like factor in [0..1] wed like partners to use. model guidance: treat it as the probability that an eviction event in region A will coincide with region B beyond independent chance. for sims, we recommend mapping to covariance multiplier = 1 + correlation_factor (i.e., +10% simultaneous spike for 0.10). we also included a per-rack_vulnerability column in the full sheet (values: low/med/high) to model tenant concentration risk.

diego-finance: please also add amortized_monthly_usd_12mo column (simple amortization given upfront_pct applied, assuming 730 hours/month) and a sample invoice_currency and tax_withholding_pct. helps our accrual modeling.

nimbus-ops: will add amortized_monthly_usd_12mo, invoice_currency (USD), and tax_withholding_pct. quick answers: invoice_lag_days 10-14 depending on partner tier, marketplace_listing_fee_pct = 4.5% (standard). prorate_policy = "pro-rate on scale-down; no refunds for early termination except negotiated RTO clauses".

amy-partnerships: operational ask from eng: can we get median preempt_recovery_time_min (how long it takes to reprovision a like-for-like spot node) and whether you offer a soft-minimum burst when commit > threshold? those feed fallback policy SLOs.

nimbus-ops: median_preempt_recovery_time_min = 12 minutes under normal conditions, 30+ during major maintenance windows. soft_minimum_burst = yes for commits > 50 instances/month, documented in sheet as min_burst_nodes. it's soft: we can throttle during 95th pct usage.

noah-business: excellent. we'll ingest and run: base-case split 65% reserved (12mo) / 35% spot, sensitivity on eviction +/- 8pp, covariance +/- 0.05 absolute. also running a cashflow run with invoice_lag 10 vs 30 days.

zara-ops: a note for the routing team: if covariance > 0.1 between region pair we treat simultaneous region degradation as a failure domain and prefer cross-cloud fallback. tagging @eng-sre for that rule.

amy-partnerships: Nimbus, can you include a short note about marketplace credit terms (do you accept vendor credits as payment; can we net fees) and whether listing fees are withheld from invoices or invoiced separately?

nimbus-ops: marketplace_credit_handling = "we accept platform credits; fees usually withheld from payout to vendors (i.e., we net listing fee before settlement)." added to sheet.

diego-finance: last ask: add sample sku-level historical spot_price_distribution (p10,p50,p90) for the last 90 days if possible. if not, p10/p50/p90 estimates are fine.

nimbus-ops: added p10/p50/p90 for spot. example: us-west-2 NC-A100-40GB spot p10=0.30 p50=0.45 p90=0.90.

amy-partnerships: great, thanks team. well ingest and post results. if any of the prorate/refund language looks problematic well loop legal. planning a brief sync after ingest to align on model-to-contract mapping. :rocket:
